decisions.reason: Although it builds partly on the firm's candle-arch tradition, the sound feature is less central to its craft knowledge base and two years without visible website presence point to limited commercial learning and a likely withdrawal.

This one-tier Christmas pyramid is very close to the firm's established woodworking and assembly capabilities, so it remains a low-risk product that can be retained and adjusted through normal workshop learning.

Because this seasonal platform depends on the same distant electronic music-box knowledge as products already withdrawn, the firm has little absorptive base for further improvement and should remove it.
The Dresden-themed pyramid stays within the firm's core product architecture and decorative know-how, making it a manageable variant to keep in the assortment despite weaker recent visibility.
